arxiv-2201-03699.creator: Matti Lassas, Lauri Oksanen, Suman Kumar Sahoo, Mikko Salo, ALEXANDER TETLOW
arxiv-2201-03699.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Matti Lassas, Lauri Oksanen, Suman Kumar Sahoo, Mikko Salo, ALEXANDER TETLOW. We consider an inverse problem of recovering the unknown coefficients β ⁡ ( t , x ) \beta(t,x) and V ⁡ ( t , x ) V(t,x) appearing in a time-dependent nonlinear Schrödinger equation ( i ∂ t + Δ + V ) u + β u 2 = 0 (\mathrm{i}\partial_{t}+\Delta+V)u+\beta u^{2}=0 in ( 0 , T ) × M (0,T)\times M , on Euclidean geometry as well as on Riemannian geometry.

arxiv-2211-01526.title: Dust temperature uncertainties hamper the inference of dust and molecular gas masses from the dust continuum emission of quiescent high-redshift galaxies
arxiv-2211-01526.creator: R. K. Cochrane, C. C. Hayward, D. Anglés-Alcázar
arxiv-2211-01526.description: Abstract Single flux density measurements at observed-frame sub-millimeter and millimeter wavelengths are commonly used to probe dust and gas masses in galaxies. In this Letter, we explore the robustness of this method to infer dust mass, focusing on quiescent galaxies, using a series of controlled experiments on four massive haloes from the Feedback in Realistic Environments (FIRE) project.

arxiv-2212-08258.title: Quantum control via chirped coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy
arxiv-2212-08258.creator: Jabir Chathanathil, Svetlana A. Malinovskaya, Dmitry Budker
arxiv-2212-08258.description: Abstract A chirped-pulse quantum control scheme applicable to Coherent Anti-Stokes Raman Scattering spectroscopy, named as C-CARS, is presented aimed at maximizing the vibrational coherence in molecules. It implies chirping of three incoming pulses in the four-wave mixing process of CARS, the pump, the Stokes and the probe, to fulfil the conditions of adiabatic passage.

MacMahon, Eskil Varenius, Robert M. Campbell, Zsolt Paragi, Andrew P. V. Siemion. Howard, Michael C. Liu, Sam Walker, Mark W. Phillips, Geoffrey A. Blake, Jean-Baptiste Ruffio, Yapeng Zhang, Julie Inglis, Nicole L. Wall
arxiv-2312-02297.description: Abstract M dwarfs are common host stars to exoplanets but often lack atmospheric abundance measurements. Late-M dwarfs are also good analogs to the youngest substellar companions, which share similar T eff ∼ 2300 − 2800 T_{\mathrm{eff}}\sim 2300-2800 K. We present atmospheric analyses for the M7.

arxiv-2404-03186.title: RAnGE: Reachability Analysis for Guaranteed Ergodicity
arxiv-2404-03186.creator: Henry Berger, Ian Abraham
arxiv-2404-03186.description: Abstract This paper investigates performance guarantees on coverage-based ergodic exploration methods in environments containing disturbances. Ergodic exploration methods generate trajectories for autonomous robots such that time spent in each area of the exploration space is proportional to the utility of exploring in the area.

arxiv-2409-05989.title: A Comprehensive Comparison Between ANNs and KANs For Classifying EEG Alzheimer’s Data
arxiv-2409-05989.creator: Akshay Sunkara 1 , Sriram Sattiraju 1 , Aakarshan Kumar 1 , Zaryab Kanjiani 1 and Himesh Anumala 1
arxiv-2409-05989.description: Abstract Alzheimer’s Disease is an incurable cognitive disease that affects thousands of people globally. While some diagnosis methods exist for Alzheimer’s Disease, many of these methods can’t catch Alzheimer’s in it’s earlier stages. Recently, researchers have considered the use of Electroencephalogram (EEG) technology for the diagnosis of Alzheimer’s.

arxiv-2508-11650.title: Generalization of Gaussian third-order Jacobsthal numbers and their new families
arxiv-2508-11650.creator: Gamaliel Morales
arxiv-2508-11650.description: Abstract . In this study, we introduce the generalized Gaussian third-order Jacobsthal numbers with arbitrary initial values and discuss two particular cases, namely, Gaussian third-order Jacobsthal and Gaussian modified third-order Jacobsthal numbers. In this paper we discuss several of its algebraic properties such as Binet’s formula, partial sum, generating function, negative subscript elements, d’Ocagne’s and Cassini’s identities.

pmc-11480696.title: Arterial Thrombosis Diagnosed With Point-of-Care Ultrasound
pmc-11480696.creator: Andrew A Gonzalez, Daniel S Brenner
pmc-11480696.description: Acute arterial thrombosis is a rare but dangerous condition that requires rapid diagnosis and treatment to reduce the risk of amputation. SARS-CoV-2 is associated with an increased risk of arterial thrombosis. Point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) can facilitate rapid bedside evaluation for both venous and arterial thrombosis and expedite treatment in these time-sensitive diagnoses.

pmc-11484573.title: Clinicodemographic and Dermoscopic Features of Basal Cell Carcinoma among Filipino Patients Seen in a Tertiary Care Clinic
pmc-11484573.creator: Juan Paolo David S. Villena, Mary Antonette D. Atienza, Nicole Marella G. Tan, Val Constantine S. Cua, Blythe N. Ke, Arunee H. Siripunvarapon
pmc-11484573.description: BackgroundDermoscopy enhances detection of basal cell carcinoma (BCC), especially for the pigmented subtype common among Asians. However, there is limited data on dermoscopic features of BCC in Filipinos.ObjectivesThe objective of this study is to describe the clinicopathologic profile and dermoscopic features of BCC in Filipinos seen in a tertiary care clinic.

pmc-11570519.title: Efficient generation of liver sinusoidal endothelial-like cells secreting coagulation factor VIII from human induced pluripotent stem cells
pmc-11570519.creator: Seiji Mitani, Chihiro Hosoda, Yu Onodera, Yoko Takabayashi, Asuka Sakata, Midori Shima, Kohei Tatsumi
pmc-11570519.description: Liver sinusoidal endothelial cells (LSECs) and LSEC progenitor cells (LPCs) derived from human pluripotent stem cells (PSCs) are expected as valuable cell sources for the development of cell therapy for hemophilia A, a congenital deficiency of coagulation factor VIII (FVIII), as LSECs are responsible for FVIII production.

pmc-12395982.title: Key regulatory genes in sugar beet's defense against curly top virus identified by network analysis and qRT-PCR
pmc-12395982.creator: Zeinab Porameri, Abozar Ghorbani, Zahra Mirsoleymani, Marzieh Karimi, Mahsa Rostami, Seyed Ali Hemmati
pmc-12395982.description: Curly top disease, caused by Beet Curly Top Virus (BCTV), is a major threat to sugar beet (Beta vulgaris), resulting in significant yield losses. This study integrates RNA sequencing, gene network analysis, and experimental validation to uncover key regulatory genes involved in plant responses to viral infection.

pmc-12419587.title: The wrapping Epanechnikov exponential distribution: A novel flexible model for asymmetric circular data
pmc-12419587.creator: Sakhr A. S. Alotaibi, Nora Muda, Ahmad M. H. Al-khazaleh, Shawkat Alkhazaleh
pmc-12419587.description: This study introduces the Wrapped Epanechnikov Exponential Distribution (WEED), a novel circular distribution derived from the Epanechnikov exponential distribution. The probability density function and cumulative distribution function are presented, together with a comprehensive analysis of its properties and parameters, including the characteristic function and trigonometric moments. Parameters are estimated using maximum likelihood estimation (MLE).

pmc-12489968.title: Здоровое долголетие - что может сделать гинеколог?
pmc-12489968.creator: Е. Н. Андреева, Е. В. Шереметьева, О. Р. Григорян
pmc-12489968.description: A woman spends more than a third of her life in a state of deficiency of female sex hormones. According to WHO, in most countries of the world the life expectancy of women after 50 years fluctuates between 27 and 32 years. Every year the number of women entering the menopause period increases.

pmc-12647780.title: tRNA-dependent conformational dynamics and folding coordinate translational regulation by a full-length T-box riboswitch
pmc-12647780.creator: Xiaolin Niu, Shanshan Cai, Junzheng Wang, Chunlai Chen, Xianyang Fang
pmc-12647780.description: T-box riboswitches regulate gene expression by sensing tRNA aminoacylation status, but their dynamic mechanisms remain elusive. Here, we present single-molecule FRET studies of a full-length translational ileS T-box, showing that its decoding domain folds independently, and the initial tRNA anticodon binding promotes proper folding of the discriminator domain.

pmc-13145881.title: The polygenic score for age at menopause is independently associated with the response of controlled ovarian hyperstimulation in women undergoing IVF
pmc-13145881.creator: Charissa van Zwol – Janssens, Sander Lamballais, Elizabeth A Loehrer, Joop SE Laven, Tjitske Kleefstra, Yvonne V Louwers
pmc-13145881.description: SummaryBackgroundWhile Anti-Müllerian hormone (AMH) helps personalise In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) stimulation protocols, a significant number of women still do not achieve an optimal ovarian response. To address this, we explore the utility of a polygenic score for age at natural menopause (ANM) as a predictor for ovarian response during IVF.

pmc-13329719.title: HEALTHCARE UTILIZATION IN PATIENTS WITH SPINA BIFIDA AND BONE FRACTURES
pmc-13329719.creator: Adrian M FERNANDEZ, Than KYAW, Debbie GOLDBERG, I Elaine ALLEN, Yi LI, Alfredo FERNANDEZ, Hillary L COPP, Lindsay A HAMPSON
pmc-13329719.description: ObjectiveTo compare bone fractures and fracture-related healthcare costs in individuals with and without spina bifida (SB).DesignThis is a retrospective observational trial.Subjects/PatientsCalifornia’s Healthcare Access and Information database was utilized to identify all individuals with SB who sought care in California emergency departments, inpatient hospitals, or ambulatory surgery centres between 2005 and 2017.

pmc-13350395.title: Transcatheter Management of Severe Aortic Stenosis, Acute Pulmonary Embolism, and Gastrointestinal Bleeding
pmc-13350395.creator: Zhouming Wang, Taotao Xie, Xin Ding, Yanbin Su, Yajun Liu, Na Zhang, Zhenwen Yang
pmc-13350395.description: BackgroundThe concurrent presentation of severe aortic stenosis (AS), acute pulmonary embolism (PE), and gastrointestinal bleeding creates a clinical dilemma where treating one condition may exacerbate another.Case SummaryA 72-year-old woman presented with fatigue, palpitations, and melena. She was found to have severe AS, bilateral acute PE, and a bleeding duodenal ulcer.

pmc-13469736.title: Sibling Relationships in Mixed‐Status Immigrant Families: A Qualitative Interpretive Meta‐Synthesis
pmc-13469736.creator: Maryam Rafieifar, Ana Marcial, Mitra Naseh, Ana Ponciano
pmc-13469736.description: This study examined how legal status differences shape comparison, caregiving, emotional strain, and solidarity among siblings in mixed‐status immigrant families. Siblings play a critical role in immigrant family life, yet research has largely focused on parent–child dynamics. In mixed‐status households, siblings hold different legal statuses, creating unequal opportunities and responsibilities that shape their relationships.

pmc-13544176.title: Translation and validation of the Korean version of the Fertility Intention Scale in breast cancer survivors
pmc-13544176.creator: Eunbi Lee, Jeonghee Ahn
pmc-13544176.description: ObjectiveFertility intention among breast cancer survivors of childbearing age is influenced by clinical, personal, and social considerations. Therefore, multidimensional assessment is essential across treatment and survivorship. Although the Fertility Intention Scale (FIS) assesses fertility intention in women with breast cancer, no validated Korean version is currently available.
